About This Website

This private redesign preserves the wording available on Pradeep Biswal’s existing website. Corrections to his biography and attributed testimonials remain subject to approval.

Portrait and Artwork

The portrait reuses Kabita Live’s existing watercolor treatment of Pradeep Biswal. Its source photograph came from the poet’s website. The original photograph and the artwork’s provenance are preserved. AI assisted the watercolor treatment; an assistant compared it with the source photograph. This is not a claim of approval by the poet.

The Missing Memories illustration is an AI-created watercolor inspired by “My Romance with Radio”: the poet recalls his father bringing home a Bush radio and neighbours gathering to listen. It is an imagined interpretation of his writing, not a family photograph or an exact reconstruction of his home. The story itself is unchanged.

The book collection includes an AI-created watercolor of an open book on a table, made in Poetic Natural mode. It is an imagined reading scene, not one of the poet’s published books. Original cover artwork is preserved; the paper edges and shadows around the covers are decorative presentation.

Award scans have been straightened using geometric rotation and perspective correction. Their lettering, signatures and seals have not been regenerated. Untouched source images remain available through “Open original image” in the viewer.

The 41 Missing Memories article banners are AI-assisted recreations based on the original images, composed to a consistent 8:5 format. They follow the original subjects, colors and lettering as closely as possible. They are illustrations and adaptations, not new documentary photographs. Original source images and generation records remain in the archive; article text is unchanged. Publisher branding was removed at the site owner’s request.

Human Editorial Responsibility

Human review governs changes to authored text, factual claims, portrait likeness and the eventual public release. No poetry or translation has been generated for this redesign. Original inner pages, photographs, book covers and the locally hosted video have been downloaded from the source site and are served by this replacement. Source placeholder text is retained. Empty sections show an availability notice and links to related existing material. Direct contact details were removed at the site owner’s request; the contact form awaits its backend.

Design and Type

The design draws on Utkal Blueprint’s principles of readable typography, purposeful art, accessible controls and traceable sources. This remains an independent author website. Cormorant Garamond and Source Serif 4 are served locally under the SIL Open Font License.
